content:
mira: Heads-up — got a customer escalated 5xx spike against hosted /v1/generate starting ~2024-11-02 08:12 UTC. They see lots of 502/504 with logs showing TLS handshake timeouts. Sample error from their gateway: "SSL handshake timeout after 12000ms". :rotating_light:

alex: Thanks — which region? any recent changes?

mira: US-EAST primarily. We did a cert rotation around 08:05 UTC but other regions rotated later. No config deploys in the window.

sam: I'm seeing transient resolver failures from the edge boxes in us-east when probing upstream resolvers. quick dig from an edge host: 
```
$ dig +short @10.1.2.3 api.redwood-inference.com A
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
```
Followed by SERVFAILs intermittently. When DNS fails the proxy falls back but we see a retry storm from client SDKs causing downstream 502s.

mira: did a curl from an affected gateway that shows handshake stall, output: 
```
$ curl -v --max-time 15 https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (34.122.12.11) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 handshake timeout
* Operation timed out after 15001 milliseconds with 0 out of X bytes received
* Closing connection 0
```

support-bot: Incident created INC-2024-338765 (pager sent to oncall)

oncall-bot: paging sam (oncall) :bell:

sam: Mitigation plan applied: forced resolver fallback on the affected edge pool to 8.8.8.8 and bumped backend connect timeout from 12s -> 20s to avoid mid-handshake cutoffs. Also rolled gateway proxies across 6 hosts to clear stuck sockets.

alex: After the fallback + restarts the 502 rate dropped from 9.2% -> 0.6% in 7m (dashboard: https://dash.redwood-inference.internal/r/edges?m=502_rate&region=us-east). Customers confirming improved behavior. :thumbsup:

mira: Root cause hypothesis: combination of cert rotation timing + an upstream internal resolver flap exposed a bug in our proxy retry/backoff where SDK retry loops amplify load during transient DNS failures. We need follow-ups:
- add resolver health-check + quicker fallback to public resolvers
- stagger cert rotation across AZs / add probe gating during rotation
- adjust client SDK backoff to avoid tight retry storms on 5xx/TLS errors

sam: Agree. I'll own the infra playbook changes and file a postmortem. I'll attach packet captures and resolver logs to INC-2024-338765.

alex: I'll reply to the customer with the mitigation steps and ETA for long-term fixes. Closing thread after postmortem.
